title: 2.5.27 Challenges — Optional Stretch
sourceRef: designed — stretch bundle drawing on Problem Set 2.5.11, 2.5.13, 2.5.14 intent

steps.title: Divide Safely
steps.instructions: JavaScript does NOT throw on division by zero — it returns Infinity. Write code that divides two hardcoded numbers where the divisor could be 0. Inside a try, throw your own error if the divisor is 0, before dividing. Catch it and log a friendly message.

steps.title: Parse a Malformed Number
steps.instructions: Given a hardcoded string like "12abc", convert it with Number(). Check what Number("12abc") actually produces, then use Number.isNaN to catch it and throw a clear error naming the bad text.

steps.title: Cleanup Counter
steps.instructions: Write a try/catch/finally where the finally block always logs "Attempt finished." — regardless of whether the try succeeded or the catch fired. Test it once with input that succeeds and once with input that fails.

requirements.title: throw present
requirements.description: Code throws at least one error deliberately
